scripts.predev: node -e "if (parseInt(process.versions.node) < 24) { console.error('Node >=24 required, got ' + process.version + '. Run: nvm use'); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w backend & npm run dev -w frontend & wait
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm test -w backend && npm test -w frontend
